content.short: Forta is a real-time decentralized cybersecurity network for blockchains.
content.description: Forta is a real-time, decentralized cybersecurity network that runs on Ethereum, Polygon, and other blockchains. Founded in 2021 and incubated by OpenZeppelin, it is trusted by leading dapps such as dYdX, Compound, Lido, and MakerDAO. Backed by thousands of supporters and hundreds of protocols, Forta’s community-run network has protected tens of billions in value from exploits. Web3 teams can subscribe to project-specific security monitoring, while developers can use the Forta SDK to build threat-detection bots and deploy nodes across chains.

resources.title: 90% of Tokens Deployed on Uniswap v2 on Base Were Hard Rug Pulls
resources.tldr: Not an estimate but a measurement across deployments, showing scam tokens are being mass-produced rather than hand-crafted. The ratio is the finding.

resources.title: A Decade of Sanctions-Linked Exposure on Ethereum
resources.tldr: Billions moved through addresses tied to sanctions over ten years, traced. Short, and blunt about why compliance screening stopped being optional.

resources.title: 1,000+ Scan Nodes: Inside an Incentivized Detection Network
resources.tldr: How a threat-detection network pays independent operators to run scanners. Interesting as a design problem: how do you reward finding nothing?
